title: Clockwork Catacomb
hero_description: a brilliant turquoise wind-up mouse with a gold key and white porcelain face
core_mechanics: power bells temporarily reverse the chase
story_premise: A clockwork mouse steals back the seconds entombed by an immortal mechanical court.
theme_thread: Every collected shard returns a stolen second while the court's wardens defend frozen time.
win_condition: Consume every time shard in the maze.
lose_condition: Lose all lives by touching active wardens.

levels.name: The Minute Vault
levels.description: a dense black-brass labyrinth with turquoise channels, ivory clock faces, and red warning lamps
levels.outro_beat: The vault's hands move for the first time in centuries. Dawn spends its first recovered second.
levels.pressure_notes: Use fast patrol and hunter routes, short power duration, many dots, and put the final shard in a covered dead end.

art_style: high-contrast brass-and-neon pixel art with crisp readable maze walls
audio_mood: rapid ticking, playful bass, and mounting mechanical panic

key_item.description: a tiny radiant turquoise diamond shaped like a broken clock hand
